$comment: BACKLOG 78 (ADR-022): app-only UI data, outside the sim pack hash like achievements.json, so editing it never invalidates saves or replays. Validated against the pack by the data guard (npm run check).

skirmish.$comment: M8 skirmish setup screen: offered map sizes and generators, opponent count limit and defaults (personality ids from ai_personalities.json, or economy).

combos.$comment: Spell combo hints: after the player casts `after`, a tip suggesting `then` shows once per match while `then` is castable. Spell ids from spells.json.
combos.text: Combo: Erode beside your new ridge to cut a moat that drowns attackers.
Combo: panicked units run blind, so a Mire in their path swallows them.
Combo: Erode the cracked land near the shore and the sea takes it.
Combo: unseen, your Shaper can walk close and Lightning the rival Shaper.

tips.$comment: First skirmish tips (settings: First match tips), shown one at a time in the objectives panel; a step is skipped once its check in apps/game/src/tips.ts passes. The last one leaves after 45 game seconds and turns the setting off.
tips.text: Press D, then click open ground near your Hearth to place a Dwelling. Settlers build it with wood.
Praying followers make mana. Press Z and click a spot to cast Bolt with your Shaper.
More Dwellings mean more followers. At 10, press T for a Watchtower or pick a Warden Lodge in the Build list on the right.
Click a lodge and train Wardens. The slider at the top left moves followers from praying to training.
Drag a box around your troops, press A and click toward the rival to attack-move.
Scout through the fog and destroy every rival Hearth to win. Press H for every key.

speed.$comment: QoL: game speed for single player matches and the campaign (keys - and =, the HUD speed control). Speed only changes how many fixed sim steps run per frame; a frame runs at most maxStepsPerFrame and drops the rest.

alerts.$comment: QoL 2: under attack alerts. A hit on your units or buildings by an enemy gives one note per place (within radius cells) every seconds; the Hearth and the Shaper have their own notes. Each alert pings the minimap for pingSeconds. Idle troops within idleGroupRadius cells count as one group for the next idle troops key.
